subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should cross-provider spend exploration become a permanent top-level Usage & Spend Settings pane, or should this aggregation live inside the existing shared Overview pattern?
rationale: The repository vision requires sign-off for new features and favors shared provider-driven UI, while both placements are technically viable and imply different long-term product and maintenance commitments.

options.title: Use shared Overview
options.body: Keep the aggregation model but present it through the established cross-provider Overview pattern rather than adding another permanent top-level pane.

options.title: Approve dedicated pane
options.body: Accept Usage & Spend as a permanent Settings destination and explicitly own its separate navigation and presentation contract.

options.title: Decline the surface
options.body: Close the proposal if a persistent cross-provider spend dashboard is not currently worth the added product and maintenance scope.

recommendation.title: Use shared Overview
recommendation.body: Keep the aggregation model but present it through the established cross-provider Overview pattern rather than adding another permanent top-level pane.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner authored VISION.md and merged the closest existing Overview and shared cost-dashboard precedents.
